# Mumbai London AF Clinic

> Specialist atrial fibrillation care in Mumbai from Professor Dhiraj Gupta, consultant cardiologist and electrophysiologist at Liverpool Heart and Chest Hospital.

## About

Mumbai London AF Clinic offers London-level electrophysiology expertise during scheduled visits to Mumbai. Professor Dhiraj Gupta performs catheter ablation (RFA and PFA), treats atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, SVT, and related rhythm disorders, and coordinates continuous follow-up with local cardiologists between visits. In August 2026 Professor Gupta performed India's first combined pulsed field ablation and left atrial appendage occlusion at Lilavati Hospital, Mumbai, reported by The Indian Express, Sakal and ANI.

## Common questions

- PFA and RFA produce broadly comparable results in recent trials; operator experience is the strongest predictor of safety and success.
- Catheter ablation is a well-established procedure; complication rates are lower with high-volume operators.
- Consultations and procedures take place in Mumbai; UK travel is not required for routine care.
- Professor Gupta is trained in both RFA and PFA and selects the approach per patient.
- Professor Gupta performs every consultation and procedure himself during scheduled Mumbai visits. Between visits, Dr Darshan Jhala (consultant cardiologist) and Dr Malav Jhala (consultant electrophysiologist and interventional cardiologist), both at Lilavati Hospital in Mumbai, provide local follow-up.
